people.imagined: His stall in Vật Hoa Thị at midday, between customers. He is grinding a lump of cinnabar in a bronze mortar and has looked up because someone said the word Peach Spring. He is delighted to be asked and is already working out the price.
people.subject: The moment: at his stall at midday he looks up from a bronze mortar with a delighted grin, one hand still on the pestle, already naming his price. Face (most important: the stained hands and round cheerful face): a wide, round, ruddy face with full cheeks, small bright black eyes crinkled at the corners, short bushy brows, a broad nose and a gap-toothed grin; smooth skin with a few laugh lines; about fifty-eight. Hair: black streaked with grey, oiled into a short topknot held by a plain bronze pin. Body: stout and short, round shoulders, leaning forward over the work. Clothing: layered silk in the colours of a pigment merchant: an inner robe of deep red silk with gold thread at the crossed collar, a second collar of cream, and an outer sleeveless gauze vest of cream spotted all over with bright vermilion and azure, wide sleeves tied back with a silk cord; a sash hung with a small jade gourd. Hands and objects: both hands held forward, fingernails and fingertips stained bright vermilion; in the left a heavy bronze mortar shaped like a small censer with a vented lid, red powder spilled on the table; a green-bronze ring set with a blue stone on the right hand. Power: a faint wisp of orange-red Fire warmth drifts up from the powder, a few red motes floating. Background: blurred market awnings in orange and blue in drifting mist, hanging jars of pigment glowing faintly. Light: warm spirit-lantern glow from the upper left with a soft golden rim light, an orange glow rising from below frame. Expression: cheerful, shrewd, a salesman who has already named his price.

people.imagined: Evening under the great apricot tree outside her clinic, a queue of the sick behind her. She has just finished rolling a needle roll shut and is checking a child's pulse with two fingers, tasting nothing, thinking of her apprentice.
people.subject: The moment: under a huge apricot tree at dusk she holds a child's thin wrist with two fingers and looks down, listening. Face (most important: faintly blue lips): a small, plain, round face, tired and kind, with faintly blue lips and shadowed eyes, narrow dark brows, a short nose, warm patient brown eyes, a few fine lines, no powder; about thirty-six. Hair: black, simply braided and pinned flat at the nape with an apricot-wood pin, one petal caught in it, softly glowing. Body: small, slight, shoulders a little rounded from leaning over patients. Clothing: a healer's robe in graceful layers of pale apricot-brown silk, a cream inner collar and a second crossed collar of faded green, wide sleeves tied back with silk ties so they fall in soft folds, a narrow sash; at the hip a rolled needle case of faded green silk, nine pale wooden needles showing at one end; on the left sleeve a small dark-green jade medallion polished dark. Hands and objects: her right hand holds the child's wrist, the child's small hand in the lower corner. Power: a faint pale-green hint of Wood qi on her fingertips, tiny green motes floating up from the child's wrist like fireflies. Background: blurred pink-white apricot blossom drifting through mist, the sky deep violet. Light: soft moon-pale spirit-light through petals from the upper left, a gentle gold rim along her cheek. Expression: gentle concentration, a faint worried smile.

people.imagined: Dusk in a harbour yard. He crouches by a sandy patch beside the quay and, without noticing, has drawn three interlocking circles with a finger. He looks up, caught, and quickly rubs them out with his sleeve.
people.subject: The moment: crouched in harbour sand at dusk, he glances up from a half-drawn figure of three linked circles in the dust, caught. Face: a thin, long, hollow-cheeked face with a high forehead and a sharp nose, sallow skin, small deep-set grey eyes under heavy lids, thin worried brows, thin lips pressed, dry stubble; a stoop to the neck; about fifty-five. Hair: thin grey-brown, tied in a small knot with a plain star-iron rod (a short dark grey-black pin), the one trace of his old abbey. Body: thin and stooped, bent forward, shoulders high. Clothing: a scholar's layered robe of sand-coloured silk, faded and dusty at the hem but well cut, two crossed collars, an under-robe of dull gold, long wide sleeves pushed back over the forearms, a plain silk cord at the waist with one small grey jade bead. Hands and objects: the right forefinger black with dust, tracing in the sand; in the left a small round shield of dark wood leaning on his knee, scratched all over inside; at his side a roll of cheap cloth printed with a pattern of stars. Power: a faint amber hint of Earth qi, a few gold motes rising from the sand lines as he draws. Background: blurred dark masts and a quay in a violet evening mist, a dim harbour lantern glowing. Light: low silvery dusk light from the left with a soft amber rim light, the face half in shade. Expression: wary, ashamed, tired, an artist caught drawing.

people.imagined: Her counting house after the shutters close. She sits very straight with a brass steelyard weight on a cord at her wrist, listening to a nervous borrower with her eyes closed, counting soundlessly on the other hand.
people.subject: The moment: seated bolt upright at a counting table, eyes half closed, she counts under her breath on her fingers while she listens to a borrower. Face: a long, narrow, severe face with high cheekbones and a straight nose, fine papery skin with deep lines running from nose to mouth, thin grey brows, level dark eyes, a thin unsmiling mouth; about sixty-two. Hair: iron grey, scraped smooth back into a tight low bun at the nape with a black lacquered pin tipped with a drop of brass. Body: tall, narrow, ramrod straight, no lean at all. Clothing: austere but flowing layers of black brocade silk, a high crossed collar over a second collar of white inner silk, wide black sleeves falling in long still folds with a faint dark pattern of coins woven into the border in brass-gold thread, a black sash; nothing else on it. Hands and objects: on the left wrist, hanging by a thin cord, a small brass steelyard weight shaped like a pear; a gold ring bearing a tiny balance on her right forefinger; her fingers on a wooden abacus whose beads are unmarked. Power: a faint brass-gold Metal shimmer around the weight, thin glints of light on the beads. Background: dark shelves and brass scale pans in blue-black mist. Light: a single spirit-lamp glow from the upper left, warm, with a thin pale rim of silver on her shoulder. Expression: patient, unmoved, listening with all her attention.

people.imagined: On the slip of the Bào yard beside a half-planked hull, in the morning tar-smoke. He is running his palm along a keel, one shoulder lower than the other, smiling at the grain.
people.subject: The moment: standing beside a half-built hull on the slip, he runs his palm along a pine plank with a look of fondness. Face (most important: the bald head and the sunken left shoulder): a broad, bald, sunburnt head scattered with freckles, a heavy brow, small bright blue eyes in deep crow's feet, a wide flat nose peeling at the tip, a grey stubble beard, a brave crooked smile; the left shoulder visibly lower than the right so his whole frame leans; about fifty-eight. Body: broad and thick as a mast, big hands, strong. Clothing: a master shipwright's layered robe of deep sea-blue silk with a second collar of pale grey, wide sleeves rolled back over the forearms, a sleeveless over-vest of pale tar-dark gauze embroidered at the hem with silver waves, a broad sash with a small brass fog bell on a cord at the belt, in frame. Hands and objects: his right hand flat on a pale pine plank; across the front of him a short heavy iron anchor on a rope, hung on the left shoulder as if it were a bag. Power: a faint pale-teal Water mist curls round his hand and the plank, small drops of light floating. Background: the curved ribs of a ship under construction, blurred in a pearly sea haze, a grey-green sea beyond, thin wisps of drifting smoke. Light: cool silver morning spirit-light from the upper left, a soft pale rim light on the bald head. Expression: stubborn warmth, pride in the work.

people.imagined: A back room of a debt broker's house in Ngũ Cốc Thành, near midnight. She sits with her back to the wall facing the door, writing left-handed, and has just heard a footstep outside. She does not look up yet.
people.subject: The moment: at night she sits with her back against a wall, facing a door out of frame, her left hand mid-stroke on a sheet of tally marks, and lifts only her eyes. Face: a narrow, pale, pointed face, sharp cheekbones, a long thin nose, dark circles under watchful black eyes, straight thin brows drawn slightly together, a flat mouth, a small scar on the chin; about twenty-eight. Hair: black, smooth, tied back low in a knot with a plain silver pin, nothing loose. Body: narrow, upright, tense at the shoulders. Clothing: a robe in layers of fine ash-grey silk, the elbows panelled with a slightly different grey, a crossed collar of charcoal over a pale under-collar, narrow sleeves with a faint celadon border; at her throat a pale jade disc on a black silk cord (a pledge-stone, plain, polished), clearly visible. Hands and objects: a writing brush in her left hand, held low; in the right a single coin with a small square hole on the table's edge, struck new. Power: a very faint greenish-silver glint of Water and Metal in the air around the coin, a few cold motes. Background: a bare pale wall and a paper-shaded lamp, bundles of tied papers in shadow, thin mist at the floor. Light: one lamp from the lower right, warm, lighting the underside of the jaw, a cold silver moon-rim along her cheek. Expression: lips flat, eyes lifted without moving her head, the held stillness of someone listening to a footstep.

people.imagined: The banker in the year before the crash, at the desk of his lending house in Kim Cốc Thành, open-handed and certain. He is signing something with a flourish and smiling at someone across the desk who has asked for more time.
people.subject: The moment: memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. He is a banker at his desk in the year before his ruin, signing with a flourish and smiling openly across it. Face: a round, soft, trusting face with full cheeks, bright wide-set eyes, high arched brows, a small plump mouth smiling generously, a double chin, a neat black moustache and a small beard; about fifty-five. Hair: black going grey at the temples, in a tidy topknot held by a gold pin and a small crown cap with a jade bead. Body: well-fed, round-shouldered, a comfortable man leaning easily back. Clothing: layers of rich dark-green brocade silk, a second collar of cream, a gold-thread border of woven coins on the hem and the wide sleeves, a broad brocade sash; the dress of prosperity, perfectly neat. Hands and objects: a brush in his right hand over a blank page; at his elbow a stack of four thick bound volumes tied with red cord; a gold counting coin on the desk; plump fingers ringless except one small gold band, sleeves carefully turned back. Power: a faint gold shimmer over the coins and the ledgers, tiny gold motes drifting. Background: dark carved shelves and a hanging lantern glowing softly in mist. Light: warm gold lantern glow from the upper left with a soft rim light, the whole picture aged and softened. Expression: an open, easy smile with warm, trusting eyes and relaxed brows, a face with no suspicion.

people.imagined: Under the largest apricot tree of Hạnh Hoa Thị in his clinic, long ago, a poor child's burned hand held gently in both his, as he tells the child's mother not to pay him.
people.subject: The moment: memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. He sits under a blossoming apricot tree holding a child's bandaged hand in both of his, looking down at it. Face: a lean, long, weathered face, kind but stubborn, a high forehead, deep-set dark eyes with heavy lids, thick white brows, a straight nose, a firm mouth just curling in a smile, a long thin white beard; about sixty. Hair: white and thin, in a small topknot with a wooden pin. Body: tall, thin, slightly stooped, long arms. Clothing: a healer's robe of flowing pale tea-brown silk, mended with matching stitches, a cream second collar, wide sleeves tied back with cloth ties, a plain sash; a herb satchel of green silk on a strap. Hands and objects: the child's hand in his, wrapped in a pale green leaf and a clean strip of cloth; a ladle and a small gourd beside him on a flat stone. Power: a faint green Wood glow at the leaf, soft green motes rising like petals. Background: a great gnarled apricot trunk and drifts of white-pink blossom in drifting mist. Light: soft spirit-light through petals from the upper left, a gentle gold rim light, the whole picture aged and softened. Expression: gentle, stubborn compassion.

people.imagined: On the white beach of Bạch Sa the first year of the jetty, a young junk-builder standing hands on hips before his first hull on the sand, grinning, pine shavings in his hair.
people.subject: The moment: memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. He stands on a white sand beach in front of the ribs of his first junk, hands on his hips, grinning, young and proud. Face: a square, open, sunburnt face with a wide jaw, thick black brows, bright small eyes, a straight nose, a wide gap-toothed grin, short black stubble, pine shavings stuck in the hair; about forty-five. Hair: black, thick, tied in a knot with a strip of blue silk. Body: broad, solid, short-legged, built like a plank. Clothing: a short layered robe of undyed pale linen-silk with a wide open collar over a blue inner collar, a sleeveless over-vest of dark tarred gauze with a faint wave embroidery at the hem, wide trousers rolled to the knee, a broad blue sash. Hands and objects: in his right hand a heavy wooden adze with a curved head resting on the shoulder; at his feet a coil of rope, curls of shaving round his bare feet. Power: a faint teal glimmer of Water in the sea air near his shoulders. Background: the pale ribs of an unfinished hull on white sand, a silver sea and a short wooden jetty in soft mist. Light: bright pearly sea-light from the upper left with a soft glowing rim light, the whole picture aged and softened. Expression: proud, cheerful, content.

people.imagined: An instrument stall in Thiều Âm Thị. A farmer has just set a green-crusted bronze bell on her counter. She taps it once with a fingernail, eyes closed, before she has looked at it, and is already naming its century.
people.subject: The moment: eyes closed, she taps a bronze bell on her counter with one long fingernail, listening to the ring. Face (most important: very long ears dragged down by heavy bronze rings): a long, oval, pale face with a high forehead, a thin straight nose, narrow half-closed eyes, thin arched brows, a thin tight smile of superiority; her ears long, the lobes dragged low by three heavy bronze rings each, clearly visible at the sides; about forty-five. Hair: black, in a tall, smooth, pinned knot at the crown with a bronze comb and two long bronze hairpins hung with tiny bells. Body: tall, thin-necked, upright, a gliding bearing. Clothing: layers of green-bronze silk with a verdigris sheen like old metal, a high crossed collar over a second collar of pale gold, wide sleeves falling in long folds, borders embroidered with bronze-thread clouds and bells, a sash of dull gold with a jade pendant. Hands and objects: a pale bronze bell the size of a fist on the counter, crusted green, struck by her right forefinger's long nail; in her left hand a round bronze mirror held at her chest, its back green with age. Power: a faint ring of golden Metal sound-shimmer ripples out from the bell, tiny gold motes trembling. Background: blurred shelves of bronze bells and old instruments in dark mist. Light: dim spirit-light from the upper left, bronze glints, a cool rim light. Expression: cool, superior, fully absorbed.

people.imagined: His river-bank stall at Đào Sa Thị, mid-argument with a boatman over the price of a ward. He is red in the face, and a half-burned seal sits in his hand while he thumps the counter with the other.
people.subject: The moment: at a riverside stall he thumps the counter with his fist, red-faced, arguing about a price. Face (most important: red face, scar and red knuckles): a broad red-faced man with a short thick neck, a heavy jaw, small narrow angry eyes under thick black brows, a wide mouth turned down, short black stubble; down the right arm and up to the wrist a long shining burn scar, the hands creased with ground cinnabar red; about forty-two. Hair: black, thick, cut short and untidy, a headband of faded red silk. Body: thick, short, muscular, shoulders forward. Clothing: a short layered robe of dark-blue silk with a crossed red inner collar, the right sleeve pushed up to the elbow to show the scar, a sleeveless gauze over-vest with a faint cinnabar-thread cloud border, a cord belt with a small jade seal bead; clean and sound. Hands and objects: in the right hand a small stone seal whose face is half burned away, held up like a warning; on the counter stacks of yellow talisman paper painted with red cinnabar strokes, no legible marks, only splashes of red. Power: a faint pale-green Wood hint curls off the damp paper and his scar, a few green motes. Background: river boats and wet wooden posts in drifting river mist. Light: pale spirit-light from the upper left, red light reflected up from the paper, a warm rim light. Expression: stung pride, wrath, wounded.

people.imagined: On the steppe road in rain, leading the caravan. He walks beside the first cart with water running off his felt coat, watching the sky as if it had a grudge, one hand resting on a wheel.
people.subject: The moment: on a rain-soaked steppe road he walks beside the lead cart, head turned up to a grey sky as if it had a grudge. Face: a long, serious, heavy-jawed face like a copy of a big man's without the laugh; wide forehead, narrow deep-set brown eyes, thick straight brows, a long nose, a firm mouth turned slightly down, a few days of beard; cautious, patient; about thirty-five. Hair: dark brown, wet, tied back in a short tail under a round cap of grey silk-felt with a small jade button. Body: tall and broad-framed like his father but lean, shoulders hunched against the rain. Clothing: a caravan master's long robe of dark grey-brown silk with a high turned-up crossed collar over a second collar of dull cream, wide sleeves, a sash, a travelling cloak of woven straw-grey gauze over the shoulders running with rain; no ornament but a small silver border of cloud scrolls. Hands and objects: his left hand on a round shield slung across the back, its rim showing at the shoulder; the right hand rests on a wet cart wheel; a bale of wool glimmers wet in the cart behind him. Power: a faint blue-grey Water hint, the rain drops around him glowing and slowing in the air. Background: a flat grey steppe, a line of carts with hoods in mist, one dry patch of pale light far off. Light: pearly spirit-light through rain from the upper left, a soft silver rim light. Expression: serious, dry, patient, a faint private ache.

people.imagined: Behind his counter in Hạc Đinh Thị at closing time, a customer's coin between his teeth. He has just bitten it, his eyes narrowed, and is still deciding whether to say it is false.
people.subject: The moment: behind a counter he bites a coin, eyes narrowed, glancing sideways at the unseen customer, still deciding whether to say it is false. Face (most important: the coin gripped in the teeth): a small, dry, lined face like a walnut, a thin sharp nose, small narrow suspicious eyes, thin grey brows, a pinched mouth with a silver coin clamped between his teeth; a goatee of thin grey hairs; about fifty-eight. Hair: thin grey, combed flat under a small black silk skullcap, a few white hairs escaping at the temples. Body: small, dry and narrow-shouldered, hunched over the counter. Clothing: layered robes of fine dark-brown silk with a high crossed collar over a second collar of ivory, long wide sleeves with black cuff-guards, a black sash with a small silver pendant; neat and prosperous. Hands and objects: bony hands spread on a counter inlaid with shell, silver and flecks of stone; small piles of shell coin, silver pieces and little pale spirit stones in three neat rows; a small brass scale. Power: a faint ochre Earth glimmer at the spirit stones, a thin silver glint on the coins. Background: dark wooden shelves of cash boxes and a lamp in soft mist. Light: a spirit-lamp glow from the upper left, yellow; a silver glint from the coins lights the underside of his chin. Expression: suspicious, patient, bone-dry.

people.imagined: A cramped room above a shop in Lam Yên Thị at night. She leans over a soapstone block with a tiny knife, the loupe on its ribbon swung up on her forehead, copying a pill seal by a candle.
people.subject: The moment: at night she bends over a soapstone block with a tiny cutting knife, a jeweller's loupe swung up onto her forehead, copying a pill seal. Face: a small, neat, pale face with a pointed chin, smooth skin, large dark attentive eyes, fine straight brows, a small closed mouth, a smudge of ink on one cheek; about twenty-six. Hair: black, in two neat buns at the back of her head tied with green ribbons, a few strands loose across her cheek. Body: slight, neat, with a slight lean forward over the work. Clothing: a robe of deep-green silk in two layers with a crossed collar of pale jade and a narrow dark inner collar, narrow sleeves cuffed back with a fine border of tiny embroidered dots; a thin ribbon round her neck carrying a brass loupe. Hands and objects: her right hand holds the tiny knife; the left presses the soapstone block, half carved with a small round pattern of dots; a few round blue-green pills on a white cloth beside her. Power: a hint of red-orange Fire warmth gathers round the candle, tiny sparks floating over the block. Background: a dark small room, a paper window pane, a bundle of herbs hanging in shadow, mist-soft. Light: one candle from the lower left, orange, strong shadows, with a faint jade-green spirit glow from the pills. Expression: quiet, intent, a little guilty.

people.imagined: The clinic yard at dawn. She has just rolled her sleeves to the elbow and knelt to wash her hands in a basin before the first patient. She glances up, brave and a little impatient, as someone calls from the gate.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn she kneels at a basin of water, sleeves rolled to the elbows, and looks up quickly toward a voice calling from the gate. Face: a broad, honest, sun-browned face with strong cheekbones, wide-set clear brown eyes, thick straight brows, a short nose, a wide mouth ready to speak, a small cut healing on one cheek; about thirty. Hair: dark brown, in one thick braid over the shoulder tied with a green silk ribbon. Body: broad-shouldered, strong forearms, upright, with the build of someone who carried water as a child. Clothing: a healer's robe of pale-green silk in graceful layers with a white inner collar, the sleeves rolled to the elbows over a second pair of gauze sleeves, a clean white silk apron-sash, a cord belt with a small jade pendant; neat and well fitted. Hands and objects: both hands in the basin, clean and long-fingered; a roll of nine wooden needles on a cloth at her side; a small round gourd by the basin. Power: a faint pale-green hint of Wood qi, tiny green motes lifting off the water. Background: the clinic courtyard wall and the foot of a great apricot tree in morning mist. Light: cool bright dawn spirit-light from the upper left, a pale glowing rim on her hair. Expression: chin up, mouth already open to answer the call, brows lifted, hands still dripping in the basin.

people.imagined: A granary yard under a hot sun. He has wound his surveyor's cord round his forearm and is pacing out a ward ring in the dust, counting aloud, quick and cocksure. Someone has said his master laid it differently.
people.subject: The moment: in a sunbaked yard he paces out a circle, chin raised, one eyebrow lifted at an unseen challenger who said his master laid it differently. Face: a sharp, sunburnt, quick face with a long straight nose, narrow bright black eyes, one brow slightly higher than the other, a lean jaw, a half-smile of conceit; about twenty-eight. Hair: black, short, bound by a strip of red silk round the forehead. Body: lean, quick, athletic, hips turned, one shoulder forward, the poised weight of a runner before the start. Clothing: a surveyor's robe of sand-brown silk in two layers, the outer with sleeves cut off at the elbow and edged in darker brown thread, an under-robe with a crossed collar of pale gold, a short sash with a brass round buckle; dust at the hem. Hands and objects: a long surveyor's cord of knotted hemp wound round his right forearm from wrist to elbow, in clear view; in his left hand a small square stone seal; in his belt a rolled little banner. Power: a very faint blue Water and ochre Earth shimmer drawn along the circle in the dust, a few gold motes. Background: rounded earth granaries with thatched roofs, a tall caravan beacon of stacked stones in the distance, in a pale glowing haze. Light: bright white spirit-light from the upper left, a sharp blue shadow under his chin, a gold rim light. Expression: cocky, ambitious, hungry.

people.imagined: Walking down a lane of Thạch Kiều Thành, he raps each wall with a knuckle and tilts his head to listen, as he does everywhere, plaster to the elbows, sure that his wards are the thicker ones.
people.subject: The moment: walking along a lane, he raps a stone wall with his knuckles, head tilted to listen. Face: a heavy-jawed, square face, rough, with a broad flat nose, thick brows, small narrow eyes, a thick neck, a mouth half open as if about to boast; white plaster dust in the stubble; about forty-three. Hair: black and cropped short, a patch of white plaster in it. Body: broad, thick-armed, short-legged, a mason's body, leaning toward the wall with his heavy shoulders hunched in attention. Clothing: robes of grey silk in two layers, the outer with sleeves pushed up to the shoulder, a crossed collar over a pale under-collar, a broad dark sash with a tool loop holding a trowel, a lead plumb weight and a small lime pot; forearms plaster-white from wrist to elbow. Hands and objects: the right fist rapping the wall; in the left a flat stone seal with a square face, held low; on his left wrist a thick cord with a flat bone bead. Power: a faint ochre Earth hint, a soft gold pulse rippling through the stone where he knocks. Background: a long grey stone wall of an arched bridge-city with a curved arch, in drifting mist. Light: bright pale spirit-light from the upper left, white on the wall, showing each fleck of plaster in the stubble, a soft rim light. Expression: head cocked, eyes narrowed in attention, a smug half-smile as if the wall had just agreed with him.

people.imagined: Her teahouse beside the ferry quay. A traveller has stepped off the boat looking lost. She smiles, pours tea, and already knows whom she will introduce him to and for how much.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a low table in a teahouse, she pours tea and smiles warmly at a traveller outside the frame. Face: a plump, round, smiling face, soft dimples, warm dark eyes narrowed by smiling, thin well-drawn brows, a small mouth, a double chin; a very calm glance that does not smile with the mouth; about forty. Hair: black, in a high glossy knot with two lacquered combs and a ferry-blue silk ribbon. Body: plump, comfortable, relaxed, with an air of friendship. Clothing: layered ferry-blue silk, a pale-blue lining at the cuffs, a second crossed collar of cream, wide sleeves with a wave border embroidered in silver thread, a wide sash of darker blue with a small knotted cord at the waist; fine, rounded, spotless. Hands and objects: pouring tea from a small teapot with her right hand; from her left sleeve the corner of a thick little book of plain blue cloth peeks out, tied shut; a thin jade band on a plump finger; a second small cup waits across the table. Power: a faint blue Water hint in the steam, which curls into a thin ribbon of pale light. Background: a window onto a river quay with a ferry boat and tea shelves in soft mist. Light: soft warm spirit-light from the upper left, cool blue reflections from the water on her sleeve. Expression: warm, patient, calculating.

people.imagined: His pawn shop beside the farewell pavilion. A failed boy has laid down a sword. He has screwed his loupe into one eye, and is looking at the boy's face with it, not the sword.
people.subject: The moment: behind a pawnbroker's counter he looks at the viewer's face through a loupe screwed into one eye, as if reading the boy who laid down his sword. Face (most important: the loupe in the right eye): a thin, patient, kind-eyed face with a long nose, high forehead, deep lines, grey stubble, an enlarged glass eye from the brass loupe on a string, and a soft honest smile; about fifty-five. Hair: grey, thin, in a small topknot with a bone pin. Body: thin and stooped, narrow shoulders. Clothing: layered robes of pale grey-blue silk, a long outer jacket of soft white wool-silk with a fur collar dusted with snow, two crossed collars, wide sleeves, a plain silk cord belt; neat and warm. Hands and objects: his left hand lies flat on a long sword in a plain scabbard on the counter, a small tag tied to the hilt; behind him a row of other swords hung with identical tags, blurred; the loupe makes his right eye look twice its size. Power: a faint pale-green Wood hint, otherwise cold, tiny frost motes drifting by the window. Background: a pale cold shop, a window looking on snow and a pavilion roof, mist. Light: cold silver moon-white light from the window at the upper left, a warm lamp glow below tracing a small gold circle on the counter. Expression: patient, kind, measuring.

people.imagined: On a quay in the northern port, a crate of cassia opened in front of her. She holds a curl of bark to her nose, ring-covered fingers spread, and is calculating the price with a smile.
people.subject: The moment: on a quay she holds a curl of cassia bark under her nose, eyes half closed with pleasure, crates opening behind her. Face: a handsome, round-cheeked, merry face, golden-brown skin, quick dark eyes, long lashes, thick curved brows, a full mouth smiling, a small beauty mark by the lip; about thirty-two. Hair: black, in a thick braid wound round the head and pinned with gold pins and a small gold crown comb. Body: sturdy, strong-shouldered, relaxed, leaning her weight on one hip against a crate with her free hand on her waist. Clothing: rich layered silk in cinnamon, a deeper brown crossed collar, a cream under-collar, wide sleeves with a stitched border of tiny curled leaves at the cuff, a fur collar gone brown with cassia dust, a wide brown sash wound twice and tied in a flat knot at the left hip, hung with a jade tassel. Hands and objects: a gold ring on every finger but the thumbs, each different; in her right hand a curl of dark cassia bark, in her left a small paper twist of pepper. Power: a faint warm red-orange Fire and green Wood glow gathers round the spice, drifting scented motes of light. Background: stacked crates and baskets of spices, a sailing ship with tall mast-tops against a pale-blue sky, in sea mist. Light: bright golden spirit-light from the upper left, a glowing rim light on her braid. Expression: delighted, shrewd, generous.

people.imagined: The pine market at dusk. He is stirring a small pot of sticky pine-root balm for the road watch, and one of the watchmen has just made the old joke about his face. He laughs, too gently.
people.subject: The moment: stirring a small iron pot over a low fire, he looks up at an unseen joker and smiles shyly, too gently. Face (most important: the long, pitted horse-face): a very long face with a long jaw and long upper lip, deeply pitted skin, a big nose, big kind brown eyes, thin brows, large teeth in a shy smile; about thirty-eight. Hair: thin brown, tied back in a short tail with a twist of straw and a plain wooden pin. Body: tall, narrow, stooped, big hands, knees bent to keep his face level with the pot. Clothing: layered robes of olive-green silk, long and clean, a second collar of pale moss, wide sleeves held back by a cord of braided pine bark, a brown over-vest stained with resin at the hem, a belt with a small pine-wood toggle. Hands and objects: hands stained resin-amber to the wrists, one holding a long wooden spoon in a small pot of amber paste; beside him a round gourd bottle corked with pine bark, a small stack of folded green leaves. Power: a faint green Wood hint in the steam, which rises in thin glowing ribbons, with orange embers floating up like sparks. Background: a stand of dark pine trunks and small lanterns in drifting mist, a watchman in a leather cap leaning on a spear at the edge of the light, laughing. Light: orange firelight from the lower right, a violet dusk sky, a soft rim light. Expression: humble, gentle, a bit hurt, smiling anyway.

people.imagined: Beside his kneeling camel at the desert well. He pulls his collar down to show a stranger the camel-bite scar before he will give his name, grinning to see the stranger's face.
people.subject: The moment: pulling his collar aside to show his left shoulder, he grins at a stranger beside his kneeling camel at a desert well. Face: a lean, hawkish, sun-black face, deep creases, a hooked nose, bright amber eyes squinting, a white-toothed grin, a trimmed black beard; about forty-seven. Hair: black, under a turban of dust-coloured silk wound round the head, the tail hanging. Body: lean, tall and rangy, hips tilted and one hand tucked into the red sash, a showman's easy swagger. Clothing: layered robes of sand-yellow silk, the outer coat with wide cuffs and a black braid trim, open at the left collar to reveal a white ridged camel-bite scar on the shoulder, a second collar of dull red, a wide red sash knotted with a long tassel, loose trousers tucked into soft boots. Hands and objects: one hand on a rope bridle; at his side the head of a camel with red tassels, yellow teeth showing; a small bag of salt on his hip stitched with small crosses; a heavy brass ring. Power: a faint ochre Earth and warm red hint in the sand, a few golden grains of light lifting in the air. Background: a dun desert and a well with a stone rim, a line of loaded animals waiting, dunes rolling to a bleached sky, hazy. Light: bright golden spirit-light from the upper left, a hot rim light on his shoulder. Expression: showy, generous, mercurial.

people.imagined: A ledger room in Nhạn Thanh Thành, the old man's door ajar behind him. He moves a bead on a jade abacus while his eyes are on the door, his memory already holding the whole page.
people.subject: The moment: at a ledger desk he flicks one bead of a jade abacus and looks up past it toward a half-open door. Face: a soft, narrow, pale young face with a gentle mouth, soft dark eyes and long lashes, a straight nose, thin brows lifted slightly in worry; about thirty. Hair: black, neat, in a plain knot with a wooden pin, one strand fallen loose across his forehead. Body: slim, narrow-shouldered, a clerk's careful posture, thin wrists, the left hand curled on the desk edge keeping the beads still. Clothing: layered robes of dark-blue silk with a high crossed collar a little too high, a second collar and clean white cuffs, a grey sash with a flat knot, wide sleeves falling in neat folds, a small jade pendant; a folded cloth in the sleeve. Hands and objects: a small abacus with green jade beads; open on the desk a thick ledger with faint ruled lines; a brush rest and a lump of ink. Power: a faint blue Water hint in the jade, the beads leaving tiny trails of pale light as they move. Background: a quiet counting room with shelves of bound volumes in soft mist; the door behind him half open on a corridor, a long dark shadow of a person standing in it. Light: cool moon-pale spirit-light from the upper left falling on the desk, a thin silver rim light, the doorway in shadow. Expression: gentle, careful, a little guilty.

people.imagined: On the harbour wall at Yên Ba, a wind in her salt-whitened braids, looking south over the water with her rope-burned hands on the stone. Her father is calling her to the yard and she is pretending not to hear.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a harbour wall with her back half-turned to the yard, she looks hungrily south over the sea, braids blowing, pretending not to hear her father. Face: a long, strong, sunburnt face with high cheekbones, a straight nose, wide grey eyes narrowed against the wind, thick dark brows, a wide mouth set in impatience; about thirty-five. Hair: three long braids bleached white at the ends by salt, hanging past the shoulder, ending in small knots of tarred twine, two whipped across her mouth by the wind. Body: tall like her father, broad-shouldered and lean, a sailor's easy balance. Clothing: a layered robe of sea-blue silk with a high crossed collar over a white inner collar, a wave border embroidered in silver at the cuffs, a wide dark belt hung with a small silver tassel, loose white trousers rolled at the ankle; clean and well sewn. Hands and objects: both hands flat on a stone wall, palms visibly rope-burned and scarred; a small iron anchor charm on a cord at her neck. Power: a faint pale-teal Water glow in the foam, a few drops of light lifting from the spray round her shoulders. Background: a wide grey-green sea and a harbour with masts, white gulls, in luminous mist. Light: bright silvery sea-light from the upper left, a bright rim light on the loose braids. Expression: restless, brave, longing.

people.imagined: At the festival's betting stand he shakes a pair of dice in his purse and winks with one eye, the other already half closed, about to tell a rich man something he will not like.
people.subject: The moment: at a festival betting stand he rattles a dice purse beside his ear, one eye half shut as if winking, about to tell a rich man something he will not like. Face: a sharp, friendly, freckled face with a wide mouth in a crooked smile, one eye permanently half shut, a thin nose, tousled eyebrows, a quick sparkle in the open eye; about forty. Hair: black and unruly, a small black feather stuck at an angle in a headband of red silk. Body: wiry, light, bouncing on his toes, shoulders loose and one arm raised as if about to start a dance. Clothing: layered silks in mustard yellow, a collar flipped up over a paler second collar, mismatched sleeves (one mustard, one paler), a double row of brass buttons, a belt of knotted cord with a small purse and a short red tassel, wide trousers. Hands and objects: a drawstring purse in his right hand with two white bone dice just visible at its mouth; his left hand holding a small round wooden tally token. Power: a hint of blue-green Water in a tilting glint around the dice, tiny sparkles trailing from them. Background: a betting stall with a row of painted counters in red and black, a chalkboard of scribbled lines, a bored clerk in a straw hat, red paper lanterns hanging overhead in warm mist. Light: lantern glow from the upper left warming his cheeks, a golden rim light. Expression: cheeky, honest, challenging.

people.imagined: In the Bào yard at evening he counts a plank length on his fingers, the three missing fingertips folded under, quietly satisfied, careful that no one sees what the copper-sheathed hulls are for.
people.subject: The moment: standing straight-backed by a keel, he counts on his hand, three fingertips missing, lips moving, quietly satisfied. Face (most important: the hand with three missing fingertips): a lean, quiet, square face, a long nose, calm grey eyes, short grey brows, a closed mouth, grey stubble; about fifty-five. Hair: grey, close-cropped under a pale silk cap, a thin curl of copper foil hooked over one ear. Body: very straight, spare, strong, a craftsman's balance, shoulders square and still like a plumb line. Clothing: layered robes of fine undyed ivory silk with a straight crossed collar over a pale grey under-collar, sleeves rolled to the elbow, a long dark tarred-gauze over-vest with a faint copper-thread wave at its hem, a belt with a small mallet loop and one bone toggle; clean. Hands and objects: the left hand raised level with his chin, three fingers plainly ending at the first knuckle; the right hand holding a flat charcoal pencil and a plank of fresh pale wood; beneath his arm a sheet of thin copper. Power: a faint teal Water hint, a thin gleam of red-gold light along the copper. Background: a half-built hull with long strips of dull red-gold copper already tacked on, moored masts against a rose-coloured evening sky in mist. Light: low rose spirit-light from the upper left, warm copper glints, a soft rim light. Expression: reserved, content, private.

people.imagined: The furnace room at Vật Hoa Thị at night. A boy squats by the fire, fanning it, his burned chin glowing red. He has seen something in the ashes no one else has, and has told no one.
people.subject: The moment: crouched at a furnace mouth at night, he fans the coals with a palm-leaf fan and stares into the red, having seen something in the ashes no one else has. Face (most important: the burn-pocked chin and no eyelashes): a thin, boyish, soot-smudged face with a chin pocked with old burns, not an eyelash or eyebrow left, round pale eyes that never blink, a small open mouth; about eighteen. Hair: black, cropped very short, singed and curling at the front like a singed brush. Body: thin, wiry, stooped, long arms, his head forward in an awed stare. Clothing: a short robe of undyed pale silk-linen tied at the front with a plain cord, two collars, sleeves rolled up, a sleeveless over-vest of scorched dark leather-gauze with a burn hole at the pocket and a patch at the knee, trousers rolled to the shin; plain but clean. Hands and objects: one hand holds a big palm-leaf fan; the other a pair of long iron tongs holding a small pale grey stone, round and smooth like a peach stone. Power: a strong warm red-orange Fire aura, sparks and embers floating up and glinting on the stone, the air above the coals shimmering. Background: a dark brick furnace arch glowing orange, a rack of iron tools and a bucket of water, in smoky mist. Light: red-orange firelight from the lower front, the room dark, a hot rim light on the cheek. Expression: awed, wordless, secretive.

people.imagined: In the clinic yard she sits down mid-sentence on a stool, fever-bright, apologises and stands again, a rolled practice bandage in her hands, while a sick child waits unnoticed at the gate behind her.
people.subject: The moment: halfway between sitting and standing in the clinic yard, she apologises with a flustered smile, a rolled bandage in her hands, fever-bright. Face: a thin, pale, reed-like face with fever-bright flushed cheekbones, large wet dark eyes, a pointed chin, thin brows, a quick small mouth; about twenty. Hair: black, thin, in two short braids tied with green silk string. Body: thin as a reed, bony wrists, shoulders drawn in, knees slightly bent and hands clasping the roll tight to her stomach as if she has risen too fast. Clothing: a simple graceful robe of pale-brown silk, a white inner collar, long sleeves cuffed back twice, a green sash tied with a neat bow, a short white gauze over-sash with a few stains of green juice at the hem; clean and well fitted. Hands and objects: hands wrapped round a tightly rolled strip of white bandage; a single wooden needle between two fingers; at her belt a small clay bottle of herbal tonic and a paper twist of dried leaves; a mortar with a pestle and roots at her side. Power: a pale green Wood hint at the roots, a few green motes floating up. Background: the clinic gate and a blossom tree in soft rain-mist, a small figure waiting far behind, blurred and dim. Light: soft pearly spirit-light through rain from the upper left, two small coins of red on her cheekbones, a pale rim light. Expression: flustered, bright, a flicker of impatience.

people.imagined: On a half-washed-out mountain path, a porter stops at a broken bridge with two sealed wooden boxes strapped to his back, and sets off through the water without a word, as he has done every day since the cure.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the edge of a washed-out bridge in a rain-swollen river, a porter hitches two sealed boxes higher and steps in. Face (most important: the face blotched yellow): a gaunt face with skin blotched an unhealthy yellow where poison once ran, hollow cheeks, steady brown eyes, thick brows, a grim set mouth; about fifty. Hair: black and grey, in a tight knot under a conical straw hat. Body: strong, bow-legged, a heavy-boned porter, bowed legs braced and the straps cutting into his shoulders, leaning into the load like an ox. Clothing: a clean, plain, knee-length robe of dark-blue silk-cotton, belted, over rolled trousers with mud to the knee, a second collar of grey, a short rain cape of woven straw layered like shingles; plain, as a porter's should be, but clean. Hands and objects: a carrying frame on his back with two small sealed boxes of pale wood bound with red cord, a blob of dark wax seal on each, unmarked; his right hand grips a pole. Power: a faint green-yellow Wood glow at the boxes, pale motes drifting from the seals into the rain. Background: the broken bridge hangs one plank over the brown torrent, a tall peak with a cap of cloud across the gorge, in luminous mist. Light: cold pearly spirit-light through the rain from the upper left, a faint silver rim light. Expression: stoic, loyal, unflinching.

people.imagined: At the money-changer's counter while her father naps. She pushes her father's too-big spectacles up with a knuckle and weighs a coin on a tiny scale, with the strongbox she has been reading half open beneath.
people.subject: The moment: behind the counter she pushes oversized spectacles up her nose with a knuckle and peers at a coin while her father naps. Face: a small, clever, round face with a snub nose, big serious dark eyes magnified by oversized round brass spectacles sliding down the nose, straight brows, a determined mouth; about thirty. Hair: black, in two high buns with red silk cord and a small jade pin. Body: small, slim, upright, sitting on a high stool with elbows on the counter and feet not quite touching the floor. Clothing: layered robes of ochre-brown silk with a clean white second collar, wide sleeves tied up above the wrist with red cord, a wide sash and a short gauze over-sash; a little too large, fitting well. Hands and objects: the right forefinger on her glasses; in the left a coin with a square hole and a tiny scratch held up to the light; on the counter small neat piles of shell coin and silver beside a small brass scale, a half-open strongbox. Power: a faint ochre Earth hint on the coins, a few warm gold motes. Background: dark shelves of cash boxes and a lamp in soft mist; a sleeping old man in a chair, her father, half-seen in the shadow at the back, spectacles dangling from his hand. Light: warm lamp glow from the upper left glinting on the thick lenses and doubling her eyes, a soft gold rim light. Expression: serious, honest, a little worried.

people.imagined: In the counting house hall, someone else is talking and he turns the heavy jade ring on his thumb, eyes drifting to the ceiling, hair perfectly oiled, bored and sure that he will inherit it all.
people.subject: The moment: standing with arms folded in a counting house hall, he turns a heavy jade ring on his thumb and gazes past the speaker, bored. Face: a handsome, narrow, haughty face, a sharp nose, thin brows raised, cold black eyes, a thin curling mouth; about twenty-four. Hair: black, oiled flat and glossy, parted exactly in the middle, held by a small gold crown-pin. Body: slim, tall, shoulders thrown back, chin up, one shoulder leaning against a pillar. Clothing: heavy layered robes of rich earth-brown brocade silk, a stiff high crossed collar fastened with a gold hook over a second collar of cream, wide sleeves edged with gold thread, a hem band of small woven gold coins, a stiff dark sash holding a small jade seal; very fine and perfectly pressed. Hands and objects: a jade ring far too big for his thumb that he turns with his forefinger; a ledger bound in brown leather with brass corners and a gold clasp under his left arm. Power: a faint brass-gold Metal sheen about him, thin glints of gold light on the ring and clasp. Background: a counting house hall with dark pillars and brass scales in mist; other clerks blurred in a row at their desks, and far off a small grey-haired woman in black sitting very straight. Light: cool moon-pale spirit-light from the upper left, a lamp in a bracket lighting half his face and a cool silver rim on the other. Expression: bored, arrogant, cold.

people.imagined: Dawn at the harbour, sulking. She has woken in a temper and scuffs out a ward figure in the sand with her bare heel, a fish-scale glitter on her wrist catching the light.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn on a sandy shore she scuffs out a drawn ward figure with her bare heel, glaring down, sulking. Face: a round, freckled, sun-darkened face with a stubborn chin, a snub nose, thick dark brows drawn together, bright black eyes, a mouth pressed hard; about seventeen. Hair: black, wild and salt-stiff, tied with a bit of fishing cord and a small shell pin. Body: sturdy, strong, bare-legged, arms stiff at her sides, shoulders forward, feet planted in the sand as she glowers. Clothing: a short layered tunic of sea-green silk with a high crossed collar over a paler under-collar, a patch of blue at the elbow, a rope belt with a small bone toggle, short trousers rolled above the knee and salt-stained; no shoes, salt-cracked heels; plain and young. Hands and objects: on her left wrist a patch of fish-scale glitter, silver-blue, shining; a small cloth flag under her arm showing a pattern of five yellow stars and a curve. Power: a faint blue Water shimmer at the scale, a few silver motes lifting from the wet sand. Background: wet sand scored with the half-erased lines of a ward, boats drawn up on the shore, a grey sea and a thin pink band at the horizon, in mist. Light: cold pink-gold dawn spirit-light from the left, the wet sand shining like pewter, a glowing rim light on her hair. Expression: sulky, defiant, quick-tempered.

people.imagined: On the ferry deck, running with a handful of notes, collar rumpled, sleep in the corner of his eye. His mother has found him another match, and he is running again, good-naturedly, laughing at himself.
people.subject: The moment: running along a ferry deck with a fistful of folded notes, collar flapping, glancing back and laughing at himself. Face: a round, good-natured face with full cheeks, small clear eyes with sleep in one corner, soft brows, a wide laughing mouth, a little double chin; about twenty-four. Hair: black, tousled, half in a knot, falling loose, a blue ribbon trailing. Body: soft, round-bellied, short-legged, leaning forward on his toes with one hand flung back, the whole body a comic rush. Clothing: flowing layers of ferry-blue silk with the crossed collar rumpled and flapping, sleeves pushed up, a loose sash, a little embroidered silver wave along the hem, soft scuffed shoes; clean and decent. Hands and objects: a fistful of small folded notes of blue paper in his right hand; his left holds up the hem of the robe as he runs; a small blue knotted cord at the wrist; two folded notes have fallen behind him and flutter in the air. Power: a pale blue Water hint in the spray, tiny drops of light round his shoulders. Background: passengers with bundles scattering from his path, a rope and rail on the deck, the shore town of a river quay with a tea house sign far behind, in river mist. Light: bright silvery river spirit-light flaring off the water from the upper left, making the edges of the notes glow, a rim light. Expression: good-natured, flustered, laughing.

people.imagined: At a stall beside the burned-out lane, she paints a ward in cinnabar-red mulberry ink with a steady hand, ink up to the second joint of each finger, and looks up proud and tense, thinking of the contest.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a stall, brush raised, she looks up from a long strip of yellow paper she is painting, proud and tense. Face (most important: the ink-black fingers, seen in the hands below): a strong oval face, olive skin, level dark eyes, firm brows, a straight nose, a mouth set in resolve, a smudge of red on the cheek; about thirty-two. Hair: black, in a neat low bun with a bamboo brush stuck through it, a few black hairs across her forehead with an ink streak among them. Body: slim, straight-backed, strong forearms. Clothing: layered robes of dark-blue silk with narrow sleeves, a pale inner collar and a second crossed collar, a cinnabar-thread cloud border at the cuffs, a cloth cord belt, a white silk apron-sash stained with ink; otherwise very clean. Hands and objects: black ink to the second joint of every finger, in clear view; a fine brush in the right hand over a long strip of yellow paper marked only with red wavy strokes, no characters; a small ink stone and a bowl of red cinnabar on the table. Power: a faint green Wood hint in the ink, a thin red glow lifting from the wet strokes. Background: a plain market stall with hanging yellow papers in soft mist. Light: soft spirit-light from the upper left, a little red light from the cinnabar bowl on the underside of her chin, a gold rim light. Expression: proud, steady, ambitious.

people.imagined: On the western caravan road at night. He sits by the fire with his brand-marked sword hand resting on his knee, saying nothing, and thinks of a woman who was not paid.
people.subject: The moment: sitting by a campfire at night, he looks into the flames, his sword hand lying open on his knee, thinking of a woman who was not paid. Face: a hard, long, silent face with a long jaw, a flat nose, deep creases from nose to the corners of a mouth that turns down, grey eyes, heavy brows, short stubble; about fifty. Hair: black with grey, cropped, bareheaded. Body: lean, hard, upright, long limbs, sitting very upright on a log, motionless as a stone. Clothing: a long robe of thick grey-brown silk-felt with a high crossed collar and a dun sheepskin-soft lining at the cuffs, a dull red scarf of silk wound round the neck, a wide belt, plain trousers; clean and well kept. Hands and objects: on the back of the right sword hand a tattoo of a caravan brand, a small circle with a spoke, blue-black against weathered skin, no letters; a plain straight sword in a leather scabbard across his knees. Power: a faint ochre Earth and cold grey-silver Metal hint, a thin cold glint along the scabbard. Background: a night camp, camels asleep with heads on the ground, a dark tent, a wide sky of cold stars over flat land, in mist. Light: firelight from the lower left, warm on the hand and jaw, a pale silver moon rim light. Expression: silent, hard, ashamed.

people.imagined: On the steps of the auction house in Vật Hoa Thị. A rich man has offered him double for what he knows. He counts the coins at the man's belt with his eyes and shakes his head.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a step he looks at an unseen man's belt, eyes counting, and shakes his head slowly. Face: a thin, pointed, quick face, small ears, black bright narrow eyes, a thin mouth shut, black-rimmed nails showing at his chin; about sixteen. Hair: black with a cowlick sticking up at the crown. Body: small, thin, quick, a street boy, weight leaning forward and small shoulders squared against the man in front of him. Clothing: a short jacket of ochre silk-cotton with matching elbow guards and a double stitched seam down the front, a crossed collar of paler yellow, a rope belt, short trousers; no shoes; plain but clean. A leather string holds a flat key at his neck. Hands and objects: hands with black fingernails, one clutching a small bundle of notes tied with thin red string and pressed to his chest, the other held out palm-up; a pill in a twist of paper tucked behind one ear. Power: a faint ochre Earth hint, a thin gold glint in the air at his clenched fist. Background: wide steps of grey stone rising to a carved door, a knot of merchants in rich silk coats blurred, a banner of plain red cloth, in mist. Light: slanting pale gold spirit-light from the upper left, throwing his shadow long and thin down the steps, a bright rim light. Expression: shrewd, loyal, unbribed.

people.imagined: A tea warehouse at Hồi Lan Thành in spring. She hugs her ledger like a child, tea stains on every cuff, and has just learned she was outbid again by the woman who pays in advance.
people.subject: The moment: standing between tea chests, hugging a ledger to her chest and frowning at a price board, stung at being outbid again. Face: a pretty, serious, round face with large dark eyes, straight thin brows drawn together, a small nose, a determined small mouth; about twenty-five. Hair: black, in a high knot with a wooden comb and a pale green ribbon. Body: slim, neat, upright, back straight and knees together, the ledger held in both arms across her chest. Clothing: a graceful robe of pale-green silk in two layers, a high neat crossed collar edged with white stitching over a cream under-collar, narrow sleeves, a grey sash tied in a flat bow; every cuff stained with pale brown rings like cups of tea. Hands and objects: a thick ledger with a dark cover held under her left arm like a child; in her right hand a tea sample on a small white dish with a blue rim, a few dried leaves curled in it like small dark shells. Power: a faint blue Water hint, the steam of the tea rising in a thin ribbon of pale light. Background: chests marked with painted leaves rising in stacks behind her, a cart of rice sacks at the door, a price board of small plain painted discs hanging above, in soft mist. Light: bright warm spirit-light slanting through a high window and picking out floating dust like motes, from the upper left, a soft rim light. Expression: serious, earnest, stung.
